title: Astonishing! A World Expanding Faster than Space

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has begun.
As for Calstone Light O—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
SAND SAND SAND SAAAND!!
Don't think something like this can bog down my legs!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her leg strength as she pursues top speed is tremendous,
unfazed by the heavy drag of the sand.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that!!
Another total victory for me today—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaahhh!?
A crab!! There's a crab pinching my leg—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the occasional mishap, she continued striving to become the fastest.
It all happened one summer day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there is something I wish to test.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We shall run across the water.
With me pulling you aboard this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she pointed at an inflatable boat
of the kind commonly seen at public pools.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Through supreme speed, the two of us took flight across the sky. Then next—the ocean!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Do you not wish to witness it, Trainer?
The scenery of absolute velocity.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I knew you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are several conditions one must clear to run on water.
Speed, power, and gravity—we must transcend all of them.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The moment one foot touches the surface, lift it instantly
and thrust the other foot forward, in ceaseless repetition—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I understand! Now, visualization training!
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaa—gh, !? Guh-haah!!
My legs, they tangled uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will overcome it, overcome it, overcome it all!
Everything! I shall transcend it all!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Light O's super fired up!
Think she'll set a new speed record in her next race!?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Nah, apparently... it's all so she can run on water.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: To the sea!! Kiyeeeeeeeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: One-two, one-two, one-two-twogluglugluglub!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Glub glub glub...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much the surrounding horsegirls buzzed, she did not stop.
Calstone Light O was steadily beginning to kick against the water's surface.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Trainer! Once more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She refused to give up.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*cough, gulp*... Puh-haah!
Haa, haa... I am ready.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Trainer, get in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sun was about to set.
This would be our final chance.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Phew... *inhale*...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash! Splash! Splash-splash-splash!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's legs hammered against the water's surface
with ferocious velocity—and the inflatable boat glided across the sea!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Did it? I did it, I did it...!
I... DIIIIID IIIIIIIT!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
!
Congratulations to you as well, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I do not know how to stop!!
Nuooooooohhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Before we knew it, we had sped all the way to an unknown deserted island.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...!
Fufu... Haah~~!
choice_data_list: We just pulled off something incredible...!
We just pulled off something incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Yes!
Well, did it not rival the view of the sky we saw that day?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There were birds.
I do not know what species, but a multitude skimming right along the water's surface.
choice_data_list: I saw a ship, too. They must have been stunned.
I saw a ship, too. They must have been stunned.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, we should have waved.
Perhaps we could have even engaged in a maritime race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...To tell the truth, I could not sleep last night.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The more I tried to sleep, the more wide awake I became.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is this? Running on water!?
A challenge of supreme velocity across the sea...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...I have no choice but to do it.
Just what will happen...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...It fills me with deep emotion.
I had never once imagined sharing the realm of supreme speed with someone.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You are absurdly slow whether walking or running,
and you dry out so quickly—I truly thought you were ill-suited for supreme speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: And yet—I came to know it. An excitement so intense I could not sleep.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What shall we tackle next?
We have conquered the sky and the sea. All that remains is the land.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Cardboard Sledding World Championship...
No, that lacks 'punch.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we race a cheetah? Enter a motorsport race on foot?
Or perhaps... aim for the fastest record crossing all six continents?
choice_data_list: L-Let's start with the cardboard sled!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Why are you cowering? Weakling, wimp, isopod.
We can accomplish all of them. I shall make sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So you and I—
Hmph... Let us live together in the world of 'supreme speed'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A realm of supreme speed that drew them both in.
The one charging at the very front is not alone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Advancing side by side, sharing the world.
The sheer joy of it made her heart leap.
